title: Gourmet Pasta Class in Washington D.C. (Includes 3-Course Meal)
includes: Full 3-course menu with salad, unfilled pasta and filled pasta
Step-by-step pasta-making guidance from a local chef
Cozy Washington D.C. venue with small-group atmosphere
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover gourmet pasta-making in Washington D.C. during this interactive class hosted through Cozymeal. Limited to 8 guests, the experience highlights both unfilled and filled pastas in a refined three-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Seasonal vegetable salad with fresh herbs and vinaigrette
- First pasta: Garganelli with savory meat sauce or farfalle with vegetable ragù
- Second pasta: Tortellini or agnolotti stuffed with artisanal cheeses and herbs in cream sauce

Guided by your pasta chef, you’ll practice mixing dough, shaping varieties and pairing them with flavorful sauces while building confidence to recreate authentic recipes at home.
